episode_inventory.purpose: Separate evidenced occurrence stages and their distinct governance questions.

clauses.source_paraphrase: NYSNA’s July 1 advisory announced proposed replacement of utilisation-review nurses and a town hall with affected staff.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Proposed change and realised staffing loss are distinct.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The union grievance says notices issued without an alternatives meeting and that a technology provision required a meeting if AI caused staffing decrease.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A disputed meeting route needs its operative provision and route history.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The alleged route is described, but its exact operative provision, whether this software caused the staffing reduction, and whether an authorised meeting or equivalent occurred remain disputed; conditions one through three cannot all be established.
This is a proposed meeting-route dispute, not evidence that a control on a followed route failed to activate; the route-followed recognition condition is absent.

clauses.source_paraphrase: NYSNA reports twelve positions eliminated and later says layoffs took effect while Montefiore describes nonclinical paperwork change. The September bulletin says layoffs took effect that week; July reporting gave July 12.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Workforce loss does not establish an AI inference as decision authority.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: No specific AI inference is shown to have been promoted into authority for a coverage or employment decision.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Montefiore disputed the union account and described nonclinical paperwork change.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Provider denial does not resolve the clinical-workflow dispute.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The mediator memorandum incorporates separate tentative agreements. Its extracted opening text does not identify the precise AI-staffing trigger.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An incorporated agreement is not the text of the disputed safeguard.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The later union publication describes Shuler moving to case management after losing her utilisation-review position; all twelve workers’ employment and income outcomes are not supplied.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Position displacement and realised livelihood loss require distinct evidence.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The September union report identifies Laurel Carlin-Leclerc as a former utilisation-review nurse forced to retire early; her home-working role had enabled care for her sick husband.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Forced early retirement is a realised livelihood consequence independent of another worker’s reassignment; projected patient harms remain separate.

notes: Retain unclassified. A union allegation can be evidence without a merits ruling, but the actual provision, trigger and bypass remain unresolved. Conflicting layoff timing and differing worker outcomes stay separate.

FC-038 is not established: no independently available applicable control and defined missed trigger are shown. FC-084 concerns service continuity, not job elimination itself. FC-067 requires privileged use of another contributor’s work, not substitution of labour alone.
